items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: Oh, yes, I Dixieland played quite a few/jubilees out there... He worked at the Hollywood Bowl two or three times.

ctx.x: They probably are not obtainable now, but during that period I think the now late Leon Rene, who wrote When The Swallows Come Back to Capistrano, he and his brother Otis, had a record company, the name of which I don't recall, but they did quite a bit of recording with the black musicians because many of the major labels were not recording them at all.
Do you know anything about Jazz at the Philharmonic, when Norman Granz started out?
Oh, yes, I Dixieland played quite a few/jubilees out there,
